title: Browser Use doesn't works on Windows
author: alexander-tempest

comments.author: Chase-Xuu
comments.body:
I've identified and fixed this issue. PR incoming!

**Root Cause:**
The default downloads path was hardcoded to use `/tmp` (line 435 in profile.py):
```python
downloads_path = Path(f'/tmp/browser-use-downloads-{unique_id}')
```

On Windows, `/tmp` doesn't exist as a standard path. When Python's `pathlib.Path` interprets `/tmp` on Windows, it becomes something like `\tmp` under the current drive root, which typically doesn't exist and can't be created without admin privileges.

**Fix:**
Replaced the hardcoded `/tmp` with `tempfile.gettempdir()`, which returns the platform-appropriate temp directory:
- **Linux/Mac:** `/tmp`
- **Windows:** `C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp` (or equivalent)

This is consistent with how `user_data_dir` is already handled (using `tempfile.mkdtemp()`).
